summary: Google DeepMind announced Gemini Robotics 2, a new family of vision-language-action and embodied-reasoning models (including an on-device variant) enabling whole-body humanoid control, dexterous manipulation, and multi-robot collaboration.

mechanisms.reason: The document states this is the first time the model can control an entire humanoid robot's whole body rather than just upper-body tabletop tasks.
mechanisms.quote: For the first time, our model can now control entire humanoid robots, translating intent into intelligent whole-body control.

mechanisms.reason: A dedicated on-device VLA model is introduced specifically to run locally on robotic hardware without network dependency.
mechanisms.quote: Gemini Robotics On-Device 2 is built specifically to handle these constraints — it is our most-efficient vision-language-action model (VLA) optimized to run locally on robotic devices.

practices.reason: Teams building physical-AI or robotics products could evaluate these new VLA/ER models for whole-body control, multi-step task planning, and vision-driven manipulation, though access is currently limited to early-access partners.
practices.quote: Gemini Robotics 2 : Our most advanced vision-language-action model (VLA) that converts vision and language input into motor control, enabling a robot to take action.

practices.reason: A new benchmark for agentic safety orchestration is introduced that engineering teams could adapt to test their own robotic safety refusal and uncertainty-handling behavior.
practices.quote: We’re introducing ASIMOV-Agentic , a new benchmark for agentic safety orchestration and uncertainty resolution.

practices.reason: Multi-robot collaboration is described as a new coordination pattern but without enough implementation detail to build from directly.
practices.quote: We are also introducing the ability for robots to work together as a team.
